predefinedQueries.queryString: select true as dettaglio, true as insert_missing_mins, true as segna_ferie, true as segna_permesso, To_Char(gdr.giorno, 'Dy') as dow, entrasp.dynamo_employer(gdr.dynamo_user) as employer, gdr.giorno, gdr.dynamo_user, gdr.min_richiesti as minuti_richiesti,min_rendicontati as minuti_rendicontati, greatest(gdr.min_richiesti-coalesce(min_rendicontati,0),0) as minuti_mancanti, gdr.motivo_validazione_tr from entrasp.giornate_e_users_da_rendicontare gdr left join entrasp.minuti_rendicontati_users mr on gdr.giorno=mr.data_rend and gdr.dynamo_user=mr.dynamo_user where gdr.dynamo_user in(select em.dynamo_user from entrasp.employers em inner join entrasp.employers em2 on em.codice_azienda=em2.codice_azienda where em2.dynamo_user='€global_username€') and (coalesce(min_rendicontati,0)-coalesce(gdr.min_richiesti,0))>min_extra_anomali_tr
